move: four huge blurred colour blobs drift while the hue wheel turns
how: Four 900px circles in pink, orange, blue and teal, blurred 90px at 0.9 opacity, sit in an oversized field on deep violet with a faint scanline overlay. Each blob sweeps x by 2rx and back with sine.inOut yoyo (one or two cycles per D) and y between -ry and ry offset by a quarter cycle, so they slide past each other; a separate lead-in tween eases y from -ry to 0 over the first quarter. The whole field runs filter hue-rotate 0 to 360deg linearly over D, so the palette walks the colour wheel once. D is 10s.
adapt: Change the four blob colours (hue-rotate moves them together, so pick the starting relationship), the background, blob size and blur radius. Keep integer orbit cycles per D and the full hue turn.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the field and four blob divs plus the grain overlay; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline of x/y yoyos and the hue-rotate tween, selectors scoped to el. Blob offsets are pixel values tuned for 1280x720.
caveats: the y lead-in tween ends at 0 while the yoyo orbit starts at -ry, so y jumps at D/4 and the y position at D differs from t=0; the loop does not close cleanly on blob position
filter: blur(90px) on four 900px layers plus hue-rotate on the parent is slow to render
duration is 10s, not the 15s listed in the catalog
